spans.s:
--a Mt. on the base (east) of Meru;
1: भा. V. १६. २६; Vi.

. २७.
residence of सुग्रीव, son of गरुड.
2: वा. ३७. १६; ३९. ३९-41; ४२. १९.
--the Sun and the son of ब्रह्मा with रजो- गुण। वा. ३१. ३६.
--a group of ten devas, born of वैकारिक, called generally digdevatas. भा.
--explains the five बुद्धि and the five कर्म senses and मनस् the eleventh. वा. 4. ६०.

(II)--the abode of विष्णु, established by Him at the request of श्री in his manifestation as वैकुण्ठ: Famous for नैश्रेयस vana, filled with different trees and birds. It had seven enclosures into which sin had no free entrance. On the seventh were stationed two guardian deities. These once prevented लक्ष्मी from entering in during the योगनिद्रा of Hari;
1: भा. III. १५. १३-27; १६. २७-30;

.
happiness (सौभाग्य) of beings retired to, during the burning of the worlds.
2: M. ६०. 2; २४५. ३४; २८५. १९.

(III)--a manifestation of Hari born of Vai- कुण्ठा and शुभ्र in चाक्षुष epoch. At the request of his spouse श्री, वैकुण्ठ (Heaven) came into existence in the Vaivasvata epoch, to the right of शिवलोक. भा.

(V)--in the Cyavana आश्रम of गया;
1: वा. १०८. ७४.
the abode of विष्णु.
2: Ib. २४. २०; १०९. १६.
--a Mt. noted for श्राद्ध offerings. Br. III. १३. २८; वा. ७७. २८.
--five: Mukhya sarga, Tiryak yoni sarga, Deva Sarga, मानुष sarga, and Anugraha sarga; three प्रा- कृत sargas; these are the conscious creations of the spirit (ब्रह्मा). वा. 6. ६५. 6.
